sections.content_text: Section 71 - Carry Forward of Depreciation Allowance (1) If any depreciation allowed under this Act is not fully charged as an expenditure against the gross income of a tax year, it shall be added to the depreciation of the next tax year. (2) Any depreciation allowance disallowed for failure to comply with any provision of this Act shall not be carried forward.
